full_prompt_en: A square color studio photograph presents a young girl in a close frontal head-and-shoulders view. Her light brown hair is parted near the center and arranged in two long braids that hang evenly on either side of her face. She has pale blue-gray eyes, light freckles across her nose and cheeks, a calm closed mouth, and a steady direct gaze. A crisp white rounded collar sits above a pale blue blouse, with a narrow dark red strap visible at each shoulder. The background is a clean, evenly lit light cyan plane without props, scenery, texture, or lettering. The camera is at her eye level and almost exactly on the central axis. Her face is rendered with very high clarity: individual lashes, tiny freckles, skin pores, fine flyaway hairs, and the woven pattern of the braids are visible. At the same time, the light is broad and soft, producing no harsh nose shadow or dramatic rim. The blue background and eyes harmonize, while gentle peach and rose in the skin provide warmth. The head nearly reaches the top edge, and the braids continue past the lower crop, creating a compact, symmetrical arrangement. No smile or exaggerated expression is imposed; the attention rests on the meeting of eyes and camera. The finish is clean and contemporary but not plastic, preserving ordinary skin detail. There is no title, border, sign, or accessory other than the clothing. The result is intensely present and deceptively simple, using direct frontal geometry and meticulous natural detail to make a familiar human face feel singular.
full_prompt_zh: 一张方形彩色影棚照片以紧密正面头肩景呈现一名小女孩。浅棕发近中分，两条长辫均匀垂在脸两侧。她有浅蓝灰眼睛、鼻子和脸颊的浅雀斑、平静闭合的嘴，以及稳定的直视目光。清爽白色圆领位于淡蓝上衣上方，双肩各露一条窄暗红背带。背景是干净、均匀照亮的浅青平面，没有道具、场景、纹理或文字。相机与眼同高，几乎完全落在中轴。面部非常清楚：单根睫毛、微小雀斑、皮肤毛孔、散发和辫子编纹都可见。同时光线宽而柔，没有硬鼻影或戏剧性轮廓光。蓝背景与眼睛呼应，皮肤温和桃色和玫瑰色提供暖调。头几乎到顶缘，辫子继续越过下裁切，形成紧凑对称安排。没有刻意笑容或夸张表情；注意力放在眼睛与镜头的相遇。完成度干净当代但不塑料，保留普通皮肤细节。没有标题、边框、标志，也无服装之外配件。结果存在感强且表面简单，以直接正面几何和细致自然细节，使熟悉的人脸显得独一无二。
style_prompt_en: Use exceptionally clear frontal studio photography with exact eye-level alignment, tight symmetric cropping, and a seamless single-color background. Apply broad soft light that reveals tiny surface detail without hard theatrical shadow. Preserve pores, fine fibers, minute texture, and subtle color variation rather than smoothing them away. Let the background hue quietly echo one small focal color, while natural warm midtones keep the image alive. Keep expression or gesture restrained and direct, with no props or environmental distractions. The visual power comes from stillness, precision, and the unbroken relationship between focal detail and camera. Maintain a clean contemporary finish that remains human and tactile.
style_prompt_zh: 采用极清楚的正面影棚摄影，以精确平视、紧密对称裁切和无缝单色背景构图。使用宽柔光，在没有戏剧硬影的情况下显出微小表面细节。保留毛孔、细纤维、微纹理和细色差，而非磨掉。让背景色轻轻呼应一处小焦点颜色，自然暖中间调保持画面鲜活。表情或姿势克制而直接，没有道具或环境干扰。视觉力量来自静止、精确，以及焦点细节与相机之间不断开的关系。完成度干净当代，同时保持人性与可触感。
theme_en: A freckled girl with braided hair staring directly into a studio camera
theme_zh: 梳双辫的雀斑女孩直视影棚镜头
name: Martin Schoeller
